message.content:
# UI QA Review — School Fee Collection Portal (390px)

## 1. TEXT OVERLAP / CLIPPING

- **Header:** "Golden Ex..." — school name truncated with ellipsis in the top bar.
- **Date pills:** "9 Nov ..." (both left and right pills) — date text truncated with ellipsis.
- **Intro paragraph:** Line 1 ends in "per fee" and is overlapped/occluded by a floating white circular button (grid icon) at the right edge — text runs underneath it: "…report — daily summary per fee…" is clipped by that button.
- **Card title:** "Extra Classes (remedi" — title clipped mid-word with no ellipsis; should read "(remedial)". This is the clearest clipping defect.
- **Sachet Water badge:** shows "WK" — likely a truncated "WKLY" chip (per spec), clipped to 2 letters.
- **Search field:** placeholder "Search learner by name, index or c" — truncated at the right edge ("...or class" expected).
- No text-overlapping-text found *within* cards; prices (₵247.50, ₵440.00, etc.) and sub-lines ("59 charged · 7 owing") render cleanly without overlap.
- No chips/badges "OPT", "REQ", "prepaid", "arrears", or per-card "₵8.00 /d" prices are visible anywhere — expected content is missing entirely (see §2).

## 2. CARD CONTENTS (per card)

The 5 colored fee cards are summary tiles, **not** collection-module cards. For each:

| Card | (a) Title | (b) Price ₵x.00 /d | (c) Collect checkbox | (d) Amount input |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Breakfast (optional) | ✅ | ❌ (shows ₵247.50 total only) | ❌ | ❌ |
| Lunch (canteen) | ✅ | ❌ (₵440.00) | ❌ | ❌ |
| Sachet Water | ✅ (with "WK" badge) | ❌ (₵0.00) | ❌ | ❌ |
| Extra Classes (remedi… | ✅ but clipped | ❌ (₵0.00) | ❌ | ❌ |
| Transport Fare (bus) | ✅ | ❌ (₵21.00) | ❌ | ❌ |

A 6th tile "TOTAL TODAY ₵708.50 · 141 charges · ₵143.00 owing" is also present. **No Collect checkbox rows or amount input boxes appear anywhere** in the screenshot — the collection card content expected per spec is absent (bottom learner card "Ama Prempeh" is cut off before any fee rows would render).

## 3. LAYOUT

- **2 per row:** Yes — rows are Breakfast/Lunch, Sachet Water/Extra Classes, Transport/Total Today.
- **Equal width within rows:** Yes, each pair appears equally divided.
- **Cut off / squeezed:** The Sachet Water/Extra Classes row appears horizontally squeezed relative to the first row — "Extra Classes (remedi" is clipped at the card edge, and its row does not reach the same right margin as the Breakfast/Lunch row. No card bleeds off the screen edge itself, but the Extra Classes title is cut by its own card boundary.
- Bottom learner card ("Ama Prempeh", "not marked" chip, avatar "N") is cut off by the viewport bottom — acceptable if scrollable, but flagged.

## 4. OTHER DEFECTS

1. **Floating grid button overlaps body copy** ("…portal — today's takings per fee…") — unprofessional occlusion of text.
2. **"Extra Classes (remedi"** — clipped title, no ellipsis.
3. **"WK" badge** — truncated chip (expected "WKLY").
4. **Ellipsis-heavy UI:** "Golden Ex...", "9 Nov ..." twice, "index or c" — multiple truncations suggest overly tight fixed widths at 390px.
5. Date range pills left/right appear identical ("9 Nov ...") — possibly the same date duplicated in a range control; verify intended start/end dates.
6. Amber/yellow stray bar under the intro paragraph (left-aligned underline) looks like an orphaned decorative element.
7. Search input placeholder truncation makes the search scope ambiguous.

**Severity:** Medium-High — missing Collect checkbox/amount input rows breaks the core fee-collection workflow at this width; clipping defects are cosmetic but numerous.
message.reasoning_content:
The screenshot doesn't show fee module cards with Collect checkboxes — it shows summary cards. Expected 5 colored fee module cards (Breakfast, Lunch, Sachet Water, Extra Classes, Transport Fare) — but there are 6 cards including TOTAL TODAY. All cards appear truncated horizontally: text clipped like "Golden Ex...", "9 Nov ...", "Extra Classes (remedi", "Sachet Water", search "index or c", paragraph "perf..." clipped by floating button. Cards seem ~2 per row but each row appears squeezed/cut at right edge — "Extra Classes (remedi" clipped, "WKLY" chip missing? Actually "WK" badge shown. No price ₵8.00/d, no Collect checkboxes, no amount inputs visible — learner section partially cut at bottom.

Layout: cards appear 2 per row but right column extends past edge? Breakfast/Lunch row looks full width; Sachet Water/Extra Classes row — Extra Classes clipped ("remedi"). Transport/TOTAL row fine. Actually all cards seem to fit width but Extra Classes title truncated.
